At 13.2 s cut to an overhead creek: brown water running horizontally between cream wavy banks, large round shaded tree crowns on both banks, a pale rounded slab in the water upper left. A white car seen from above sits at the right where the water meets the lower bank, soft rounded white foam blobs at its right end. Its roof shows a dark glass panel with a round sensor and small gray rectangles toward the rear; whether these read as empty seats is not certain at phone size. The water carries short wavy white strokes and dots in loose rows; no V wake and no long streamline. The car barely moves through 13.8 s. Car sits above the caption box.
